title: Book Three · Chapter 73: Bread Before Breakfast
story:
On Sunday, Ronan walks to the bread shop before breakfast.

The air is cold. His ears hurt. He pulls his collar up. Then he puts his gloved hands into his pockets.

Ronan reaches the shop. A fresh tray of bread comes out. He buys enough plain bread for three people. He pays with his own small coins.

There is change. He puts it away before he takes the bag.

On the way home, the warm paper rests against his coat. He does not eat from it this time.

At home, Mum is opening the window. Dad has put three bowls on the table.

“The buyer,” Dad says.

“The bread too.”

Ronan sets the bag between them. Mum takes the first piece. She breaks it and lets the warm air out.

“You chose well.”

He sits down with his own piece. Dad pours hot water into the cups. For a while, they eat and listen to the lane outside.

A few days ago, Ronan started his next reply to Leo. After breakfast, he finishes that letter. He writes about the winter work. Then he describes Dad's road map.

He asks about the streets near the station. He also asks about jobs there.

He sends this twelfth letter before lunch. Then he comes home. He reads his school book for a while.

In the afternoon, he meets Kai at the park. The grass is wet, so they leave the ball in its bag. They walk round the path together.

Kai tells him about a question from class. He needed time, but he finished it without help.

“The whole thing?” Ronan asks.

“Even the last sentence.”

“You saved air for it.”

Kai laughs and taps the bag gently against his knee.

Near the far gate, Anna and Lin come toward them. They have walked from the library, not the track. Anna's book is inside a plain cover now.

“Protection from the rain,” she says.

The four walk together for part of the path. Lin talks about her grandmother. Kai has left an orange at home. Now he remembers it.

Ronan looks at Anna. She is listening to Lin. Her hair moves against the side of her coat. He wants to ask about the other city again. Lin is still telling her story.

He waits. Anna catches his eye and smiles. Then she turns back to Lin.

At the gate, everyone needs a different road. They agree to see each other at school tomorrow.

Ronan takes the short way to West Lane. Inside the green door, Mum is checking her cushion cloth. Dad has finished the washing. The clean clothes are in the sun.

Ronan hangs his coat and puts his gloves beside it. The bread bag is empty on the kitchen shelf. Tomorrow, he will need his school bag again.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

plain＝普通无馅的、朴素的；buyer＝买东西的人；protection＝保护；catch someone's eye＝与某人目光相遇。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan有没有兑现给家里买面包的约定？这笔钱从哪里来？
2. 他和Anna是否已经决定共同的未来？公园里实际发生了怎样的相处？

## 读句子

**Anna catches his eye and smiles.**

拆开看：Anna / catches his eye / and smiles.

Anna／与他目光相遇／笑了笑。
